Alleghany Del (Y) Shareholder London Co Of Virginia Cut Holding by $1.81 Million as Shares Rose; Azimuth Capital Management Has Increased Its At&T (T) Position by $375,364; Market Value Declined
May 1, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
London Co Of Virginia decreased its stake in Alleghany Corp Del (Y) by 1.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. London Co Of Virginia sold 3,039 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.88% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 197,901 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $117.97M, down from 200,940 at the end of the previous reported quarter. London Co Of Virginia who had been investing in Alleghany Corp Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $8.98B market cap company. The stock increased 1.44% or $8.26 during the last trading session, reaching $582.93. About 54,994 shares traded. Alleghany Corporation (NYSE:Y) has declined 2.82% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.37% the S&P500.
Azimuth Capital Management Llc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 3.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
